The Musée national d’histoire = former École française d’Extrême-Orient at Tràng Tiền is stated from general knowledge, not source-checked; flagged 'horaires à vérifier'. Price: only owner range for automatic scooter 150 000–200 000 VND/day with disclaimer. Pickup opening 09:00 only. No deposit, delivery, insurance, assistance or fleet statement.
